title: Maryland enacts oversight boards for transit and commuter services
summary: The state’s six-year, $22.1 billion transportation plan includes completion of a light rail line connecting two counties bordering Washington, D.C.

title: 3 cities making strides in housing affordability
summary: Ivory Innovations recognized a housing finance program in Boston and housing policies in Chattanooga, Tennessee, and New Rochelle, New York, for their ingenuity.

title: Aging infrastructure, climate risks shake water sector confidence: report
summary: Century-old systems, extreme weather, cyberthreats and regulatory inconsistencies threaten future water supply and resilience, the American Water Works Association found.

title: Archer, Joby expect to begin commercial air taxi flights in US cities this year
summary: “The goal is to have half a million people in the biggest cities in the country start to see these aircraft as part of your everyday commute,” Archer Aviation’s CEO said.

title: HUD trims environmental reviews for multifamily projects
summary: Streamlined standards could help ease affordability pressures nationwide, federal officials and housing industry leaders say.

title: These 12 cities are leading on environmental health, African American Mayors Association says
summary: AAMA and the Community Data Health Initiative are highlighting municipalities using data, partnerships and targeted infrastructure strategies to address heat, pollution and lead risks.

title: Illinois cities push back on state proposal to bypass local zoning
summary: After Gov. JB Pritzker proposed sweeping statewide housing measures, municipal groups say they’re expanding housing options on their own terms.

title: DOJ targets ‘sanctuary’ rules in Albuquerque, New Mexico
summary: Albuquerque, New Mexico, joins a growing list of cities facing federal lawsuits over immigration enforcement policies. “We are ready to defend our community,” the city’s mayor said.

title: Meeting the demand for resilient construction
summary: GAF, in alliance with IBHS, has trained 1,100+ roofing professionals to install FORTIFIED™ roofs, helping communities meet growing demand for resilient homes.

title: Providence, Rhode Island, updates recycling, organics with $3.6M in grants
summary: Free commercial recycling service, residential recycling carts and organics infrastructure are among the changes the city has made with the help of EPA and USDA funding.
